name: ChatGPT
description: Get instant answers, write content, code and more with ChatGPT.
longDescription: ChatGPT is the industry-leading conversational AI model by OpenAI. It excels at answering complex questions, brainstorming ideas, writing code in dozens of languages, summarizing lengthy documents, and generating creative or technical text.

name: Midjourney
description: Create stunning AI images from simple text prompts.
longDescription: Midjourney generates astonishing photorealistic and artistic images from descriptive natural language prompts. Favored by artists, game developers, concept designers, and creative directors.

name: Canva
description: Design anything with AI-powered tools and templates.
longDescription: Canva integrates AI Magic Studio tools to automatically generate presentations, remove backgrounds, erase elements, expand photos, and create social media designs with minimal effort.

name: Runway
description: Create and edit videos with powerful AI tools.
longDescription: Runway provides next-generation Gen-2 and Gen-3 Alpha video generation models, video-to-video style transfers, motion brush control, green screen rotoscoping, and audio generation for professional filmmakers.

name: Leonardo AI
description: Generate high-quality images, art and assets with AI.
longDescription: Leonardo AI is a specialized creative suite tailored for game developers, character creators, and visual artists with real-time canvas generation, 3D texture mapping, and fine-tuned community models.

name: Claude
description: Analyze documents, write nuanced prose, and solve difficult logic problems with Claude.
longDescription: Claude by Anthropic features extraordinary reasoning capabilities, massive context windows, and code analysis with unmatched clarity and ethical alignment.

name: Cursor
description: The AI-first Code Editor built to supercharge engineer productivity.
longDescription: Cursor is a fork of VS Code engineered from the ground up for collaborative AI programming with whole-codebase indexing, multi-file edits, and instant terminal command suggestions.

name: ElevenLabs
description: Hyper-realistic voice cloning, text-to-speech, and audio sound effects generator.
longDescription: ElevenLabs produces rich, emotionally resonant synthesized speech in dozens of languages, alongside custom voice cloning and instantaneous video dubbing.
